title: helperConsumers
responsibility: Counts distinct active components, services and functions using each exported helper at one revision.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.tree
inputs.description: The selected source tree. Reads and optional file listings describe this exact revision, rather than files from another checkout.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.units
inputs.description: Registered units and their owned source. Each helper receives distinct actual component, service or named-function consumers in this array.

outputs.name: helperConsumers
outputs.description: Completes after attaching consumer facts to the supplied helper metadata; it returns no separate value.
